messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

I'm sorry, Robert. I need to correct what I told you earlier: nobody is going to come into this chat tonight. The team went offline at 6pm ET. Your request is already with them as the first thing that needs a decision. That means the Thor P2 you were offered at no cost, or the QX1 you ordered.

They're back tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer will come to your email, so you don't need to keep this window open. If they approve the Thor P2, I'll make the swap. It's on the US shelf and ships within 2 business days.
